#### Get Started

# X Premium Customers moving to The X Subscription

The X Subscription brings Grok, Cursor, and X together in one plan. You don't need an existing X Premium subscription to switch.

Your X benefits depend on your plan and apply once you connect a personal X account:

* Free: Standard X
* Plus: a checkmark, creator tools, and fewer ads on X
* Premium, Super, and Ultra: full X Premium+ benefits

If you have X Premium+ today, choose Premium or higher to keep your X Premium+ benefits. Team plan seats include X benefits too. Each member gets them by connecting their own personal X account.

Only personal X accounts can be connected. X accounts managed by an organization, including affiliate accounts, can’t be connected.

For who can switch or combine accounts, see [Unification eligibility: Who can combine accounts?](/x-subscription/eligibility).

## What happens to my X Premium when I switch?

If you pay for X Premium or X Premium+ on the X account you connect:

* That subscription is cancelled when you switch.
* You get an automatic refund for the unused time. It's sent separately and isn't subtracted from what you pay at checkout (see [Invoices & Refunds](/x-subscription/invoices-and-refunds)). If you bought X Premium through the Apple App Store, we ask Apple to refund the unused time, and Apple decides on the refund.
* Your plan on The X Subscription replaces it, and your X benefits come from The X Subscription instead of a separate X bill.

If you bought Grok, Grok Bot, or X Premium through Google Play, check your subscriptions in Google Play after you switch. If it's still set to renew, cancel it there.

## How to switch

How you switch depends on whether you have a paid Cursor plan.

### If you have a paid Cursor plan

Start from Cursor so your Cursor account is unified with your X account and, if you have one, your Grok account.

1. Go to [cursor.com/unify](https://cursor.com/unify) and click **Get started**.
2. Select **X**, plus **Grok** if you have a Grok account, and click **Start linking accounts**.
3. If you're adding Grok: sign in and confirm the account.
4. Sign in to the X account that has your X Premium, and authorize the connection.
5. Choose your plan under The X Subscription (**Plus**, **Premium**, **Super**, or **Ultra**), then review the details and proceed to checkout. Your X benefits appear after you switch. Linking your X account can take a little time.

For the full steps, see [How to unify accounts under The X Subscription](/x-subscription/unify-accounts).

### If you don't have a paid Cursor plan

You can switch right from X. Starting from X doesn't include Cursor. If you have a paid Cursor plan, start from Cursor.

1. On [x.com](https://x.com), open your subscription settings and select the option to upgrade.
2. Choose your new plan (**Plus**, **Premium**, **Super**, or **Ultra**).
3. If you're asked to add a Grok account, sign in to add it.
4. Review your plan and finish checkout on [x.com](https://x.com).

## Already unified without connecting X?

Contact Support if you unified without connecting X, or if your X benefits are missing after you connected X during the switch.
